liquidity_funding.text: Cash and cash-like investments rose by {{cash_like.change@FY2024}} to {{cash_like@FY2024}}, taking cash liquidity to revenue up by {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue.change@FY2024}} to {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue@FY2024}}, above the peer median of {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue.peer_median@FY2024}}.

Debt due within one year was stable at {{debt_due_1y@FY2024}}, so cash of {{cash_like@FY2024}} covers the near-term maturities without new funding, and the group issued a euro-denominated guaranteed bond under its EMTN programme maturing in 2031.

Free cash flow after lease payments fell by {{fcf_after_leases.change@FY2024}} to {{fcf_after_leases@FY2024}}, or {{fcf_after_leases_to_debt@FY2024}} of debt, down {{fcf_after_leases_to_debt.change@FY2024}}, as net capex rose by {{net_capex.change@FY2024}} to {{net_capex@FY2024}}.

Customer prepayments remain a large part of the funding base: contract liabilities rose by {{contract_liabilities.change@FY2024}} to {{contract_liabilities@FY2024}}, with advance ticket cover of {{advance_ticket_cover@FY2024}} in line with the peer median.

watch_items.text: Cash generation: free cash flow after lease payments fell by {{fcf_after_leases.change@FY2024}} to {{fcf_after_leases@FY2024}}, taking FCF after leases to debt down by {{fcf_after_leases_to_debt.change@FY2024}} to {{fcf_after_leases_to_debt@FY2024}}.

Investment: capex intensity rose by {{capex_intensity.change@FY2024}} to {{capex_intensity@FY2024}}, above the peer median of {{capex_intensity.peer_median@FY2024}}, with significant investment in spares to limit aircraft grounding.
Unit costs: CASK rose by {{cask.change@FY2024}} to {{cask@FY2024}} and CASK ex-fuel by {{cask_ex_fuel.change@FY2024}} to {{cask_ex_fuel@FY2024}}, so the cost base moved against the group.
Profitability: the EBITDA margin of {{ebitda_margin@FY2024}} is the weakest of the low-cost group ({{ebitda_margin.peer_rank@FY2024}}), below the peer median of {{ebitda_margin.peer_median@FY2024}}.
